risk_factors: Exclusive dealing commitment without clear scope limitations - distributor must market Airspan Products exclusively in the Territory
Vague definition of 'Territory' - geographic scope is not specified in provided text, creating ambiguity about exclusivity boundaries
Incomplete clause text - sentence cuts off mid-paragraph ('grants to Distributor only a license to resell the'), preventing full risk assessment
No visible termination provisions or duration limits mentioned - unclear when exclusivity ends or how it can be modified
Unclear post-termination restrictions - no explicit statement whether exclusivity obligations survive contract termination
Potential conflict between 'exclusive distributor' appointment and 'independent' status - could create disputes over control and obligations
Missing clarity on 'requirements' commitment - no specification of minimum sales obligations, performance metrics, or exclusivity enforcement mechanisms
